t: You're looking at the St James's Hotel and Club, at 7 and 8 Park Place in St James's, London SW1A 1LP. It's part of the Nishat Group, a Pakistani multinational conglomerate. The group is owned by Mian Mohammad Mansha, who is chairman of MCB Bank and one of the wealthiest people in Pakistan. His family owns Nishat, so this small hotel in the heart of St James's belongs to one of Pakistan's best-known business groups.
